description: This PHP source file defines the 'FilterField' entity class used within a Doctrine ORM setup for the OrangeHRM system. The class represents a database table 'ohrm_filter_field' with properties for various filter field attributes, including relationships to other entities and methods for property access and modification.

classes.name: FilterField
classes.description: Entity class representing a filter field used in report filtering within the OrangeHRM system. It contains properties for identifying the filter, its display widget, conditions, and associated report group.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the filter field's unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the filter field's unique identifier.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Associates a ReportGroup entity with this filter field.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the filter field.

methods.name: getWhereClausePart
methods.description: Returns the SQL part of the WHERE clause related to this filter.

methods.name: setWhereClausePart
methods.description: Sets the SQL part of the WHERE clause.

methods.name: getFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Returns the widget type used for the filter (e.g., dropdown, textbox).

methods.name: setFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Sets the widget type for the filter.

methods.name: getConditionNo
methods.description: Returns the condition number used to determine filter behavior.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Indicates whether this filter field is required.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the filter field is required.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the optional class name associated with the filter field.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name for the filter field.
